Ab us bachay ke paas hajat-mand logon ka tanta lag gaya aur us ki dua se madar-zad andhay, korhi, juzami aur har qism ke beemar achay hone lagay. Badshah ke ek nabina wazeer ke kaan mein bhi yeh aawaz pari, woh baray tahaif le kar hazir hua aur kehne laga ke agar tu mujhe shifa de de to yeh sab tujhe de doon ga. Us ne kaha shifa mere hath nahin, main kisi ko shifa nahin de sakta, shifa dene wala Allah Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu hai, agar tu is par imaan lane ka wada kare to main is se dua karoon. Us ne iqrar kiya, bachay ne us ke liye dua ki, Allah ne usay shifa de di aur badshah ke darbar mein aaya aur jis tarah andha hone se pehle kaam karta tha karne laga, aur aankhein bilkul roshan thin. Badshah ne muta'ajib ho kar poocha ke tujhe aankhein kis ne dein? Us ne kaha mere Rabb ne. Badshah ne kaha haan yani main ne? Wazeer ne kaha nahin nahin, mera aur tera Rabb Allah hai. Badshah ne kaha achha to kya mere siwa tera koi aur bhi Rabb hai? Wazeer ne kaha haan mera aur tera Rabb Allah Azza-o-Jal hai.

Ab us ne usay maar peet shuru kar diya aur tarah tarah ki takleefain aur eezayein pohanchane laga aur poochne laga ke tujhay yeh taleem kis ne di? Aakhir us ne bata diya ke is bachay ke haath par main ne Islam qabool kiya aur us ne usay bulwaya aur kaha ab to tum jaadu mein khoob kaamil ho gaye ho ke andhon ko dekhta aur beemaron ko tandurust karne lag gaye. Us ne kaha ghalat hai na main kisi ko shifa de sakta hoon na jaadu, shifa to Allah Azza-wa-Jal ke haath mein hai. Kehne laga haan yani mere haath mein hai, kyunke Allah to main hi hoon. Us ne kaha hargiz nahin, kaha phir kya tu mere siwa kisi aur ko Rabb maanta hai? To woh kehne laga haan! Mera aur tera Rabb Allah Ta'ala hai. Us ne ab usay bhi tarah tarah ki sazayein deni shuru keen yahan tak ke raahib ka pata laga liya. Raahib ko bula kar us ne kaha ke tu Islam ko chhor de aur is deen se palat ja, us ne inkaar kiya to us baadshah ne aaray se us ke chehray ko cheer diya aur theek do tukray kar ke phenk diya. Phir us naujawan se kaha ke tu bhi deen se phir ja magar us ne bhi inkaar kar diya to baadshah ne hukum diya ke hamaray sipahi usay falaan falaan pahaar par le jayen aur us ki buland choti par pohanch kar phir usay us ke deen chhor dene ko kahein agar maan le to achha warna wahin se lurhka dein. Chunancha yeh log usay le gaye jab wahan se dhakka dena chaha to us ne Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala se dua ki (Allahumma ikfinihim bima shi'ta) Allah jis tarah chahay mujhe in se najaat de, is dua ke saath pahaar hila aur woh sab sipahi lurhak gaye sirf woh bacha bacha raha, wahan se woh utra aur hansi khushi phir us zaalim baadshah ke paas aa gaya, baadshah ne kaha yeh kya hua mere sipahi kahan hain? Farmaya mere Allah ne mujhe in se bacha liya. Us ne kuch aur sipahi bulwaye aur un se bhi yahi kaha ke usay kashti mein bitha kar le jao, aur beechon beech samundar mein dubo kar chalay aao. Yeh usay le kar chalay aur beech mein pohanch kar jab samundar mein phenkna chaha to us ne phir wahi dua ki ke Baar-e-Ilahi jis tarah chahay mujhe in se bacha, mauj uthi aur woh sipahi saaray ke saaray samundar mein doob gaye sirf woh bacha hi baqi reh gaya. Yeh phir baadshah ke paas aaya, aur kaha mere Rabb ne mujhe in se bhi bacha liya. Ae baadshah tu chahay tamam tadbeerein kar daal lekin mujhe halak nahin kar sakta haan jis tarah main kahoon is tarah agar karay to albatta meri jaan nikal jaye gi. Us ne kaha kya karoon? Farmaya tu logon ko aik maidan mein jama kar phir khajoor ke tanay par sooli charha aur mere tarkash mein se aik tinka nikaal meri kamaan par charha aur Bismillahi Rabb-e-Hazal Ghulaam yani isi Allah ke naam se jo is bachay ka Rabb hai keh kar woh teer meri taraf phenk woh mujhe lagay ga aur is se main maroon ga. Chunancha baadshah ne yahi kiya teer bachay ki kanpatti mein laga us ne apna haath us jagah rakh liya aur shaheed ho gaya.

Us ke is tarah shaheed hote hi logon ko us ke deen ki sachai ka yaqeen aa gaya. Charon taraf se yeh aawazein uthne lageen ke hum sab is bachay ke Rabb par imaan la chukay. Yeh haal dekh kar badshah ke musahib ghabraye aur badshah se kehne lage is larkay ki tarkeeb hum samjhay hi nahin, dekhiye is ka yeh asar para ke yeh tamam log is ke mazhab par ho gaye. Hum ne to isi liye qatl kiya tha ke kahin yeh mazhab phail na jaye lekin woh dar to samnay hi aa gaya aur sab musalman ho gaye. Badshah ne kaha achha yeh karo ke tamam mohallon aur raston mein khandaqein khudwao, in mein lakriyan bharo aur is mein aag laga do. Jo is deen se phir jaye usay chor do aur jo na manay usay is aag mein daal do. In musalmanon ne sabr-o-zabt ke sath aag mein jalna manzoor kar liya aur is mein kood kood kar girnay lagay. Albata ek aurat jis ki god mein doodh peeta chota bacha tha woh zara hichkichayi to us bachay ko Allah Ta'ala ne bolnay ki taqat di, us ne kaha amma kya kar rahi ho tum to haq par ho, sabr karo aur is mein kood paro. Yeh hadees Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi hai aur Sahih Muslim ke aakhir mein bhi hai aur Nasai mein bhi qudrat-e-ikhtisar ke sath hai. Tirmidhi Shareef ki hadees mein hai Hazrat Suhaib (R.A) farmatay hain ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) asr ki namaz ke baad umooman zer-e-lab kuch farmaya kartay thay, to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha ke huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya farmatay hain? Farmaya nabiyon mein se ek nabi thay jo apni ummat par fakhr kartay thay, kehne lage ke in ki dekh bhaal kaun kare ga? To Allah Ta'ala ne un ki taraf wahi bheji ke inhein ikhtiyar hai khwah is baat ko pasand karein ke main khud in se inteqam loon, khwah is baat ko pasand karein ke main in par in ke dushmanon ko musallat karoon. Unhon ne inteqam ko pasand kiya, chunancha ek hi din mein in mein se sattar hazar mar gaye. Is ke sath hi aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh hadees bhi bayan ki jo oopar guzri, phir aakhir mein aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne qatl se majeed tak ki aayaton ki tilawat farmayi. Yeh naujawan shaheed dafan kar diye gaye thay aur Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ki khilafat ke zamana mein in ki qabr se inhein nikala gaya tha, in ki ungli isi tarah in ki kanpati par rakhi hui thi jis tarah ba-waqt-e-shahadat thi. Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) isay Hasan Ghareeb batlatay hain lekin is riwayat mein yeh sarahat nahin ke yeh waqia Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bayan farmaya, to mumkin hai ke Hazrat Suhaib Rumi (R.A) ne hi is waqia ko bayan farmaya ho, in ke paas nasraniyon ki aisi hikayatein bohat sari thin, Wallahu A'lam. Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq (R.H) ne bhi is qissa ko doosray alfaz mein bayan farmaya hai, jo is ke khilaf hai. Woh kehte hain ke Najrani log but-parast mushrik thay, aur Najran ke paas ek chota sa gaon tha jis mein ek jadugar tha, Najraniyon ko jadoo sikhaya karta tha. Faimoon nami ek buzurg aalim yahan aaye aur Najran aur us ke gaon ke darmiyan unhon ne apna parao dala.

Shahar ke ladke jo jadugar se jadu seekhne jaya karte the un mein tajir ka ek ladka Abdullah nami bhi tha, use aate jaate rahib ki ibadat aur us ki namaz wagairah ke dekhne ka mauqa milta, is par gaur-o-khauz karta aur dil mein us ke mazhab ki sachai jagah karti jati, phir to us ne yahan aana jana shuru kar diya aur mazhabi taleem bhi us rahib se lene laga. Kuch dinon baad us mazhab mein dakhil ho gaya aur Islam qabool kar liya, tauheed ka paband ho gaya aur ek Allah ki ibadat karne laga aur ilm-e-deen achi tarah hasil kar liya. Woh rahib Ism-e-Azam bhi janta tha, us ne harchand khwahish ki ke use bata de lekin us ne na bataya aur keh diya ke abhi tum mein is ki salahiyat nahin aayi, tum abhi kamzor dil wale ho, is ki taqat mein tum mein nahin pata. Abdullah ke baap tamir ko apne bete ke musalman ho jane ki mutlaq khabar na thi, woh apne nazdeek yahi samajh raha tha ke mera beta jadu seekh raha hai aur wahin jata aata rehta hai. Abdullah ne jab dekha ke rahib mujhe Ism-e-Azam nahin sikhate aur unhein meri kamzori ka khauf hai to ek din unhon ne teer liye aur jitne naam Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ke unhein yaad the har teer par ek naam likha, phir aag jala kar baith gaya aur ek ek teer ko us mein dalna shuru kiya, jab woh teer aaya jis par Ism-e-Azam tha to woh aag mein padte hi uchal kar bahar nikal aaya aur us par aag ne bilkul asar na kiya, samajh liya ke yahi Ism-e-Azam hai. Apne ustad ke paas aaye aur kaha Hazrat Ism-e-Azam ka ilm mujhe ho gaya, ustad ne poocha batao kya hai? Us ne bataya, rahib ne poocha kaise maloom hua to us ne sara waqia keh sunaya, farmaya bhai tum ne khoob maloom kar liya waqai yahi Ism-e-Azam hai, ise apne hi tak rakho lekin mujhe to dar hai ke tum khul jaoge. Un ki yeh halat hui ke yeh Najran mein aaye, yahan jis bimar par, jis dukhi par, jis sitam-rasida par nazar padi us se kaha ke agar tum muwahid ban jao aur deen-e-Islam qabool kar lo to main Rabb se dua karta hoon woh tumhein shifa aur nijat de dega aur dukh bala ko taal dega, woh use qabool kar leta, yeh Ism-e-Azam ke sath dua karte Allah use bhala changa kar deta. Ab to Najraniyon ke thath lagne lage aur jamaat ki jamaat rozana musharraf-ba-Islam aur faiz-ul-maram hone lagi, aakhir badshah ko is ka ilm hua, us ne use bula kar dhamkaya ke tu ne meri raiyat ko bigad diya aur mere aur mere baap dada ke mazhab par hamla kiya, main is ki saza mein tere hath paon kaat kar tujhe chauraha par rakhwa doonga.

Abdullah bin Tamir ne jawab diya ke tu aisa nahin kar sakta. Ab badshah ne use pahar par se gira diya lekin woh neeche aa kar sahih salamat raha, jism par kahin chot bhi na aayi. Najran ke un toofan-khez daryaoon mein gardab ki jagah unhein la dala jahan se koi bach nahin sakta lekin yeh wahan se bhi sehat-o-salamti ke sath wapas aa gaye. Garz har tarah aajiz aa gaya to phir Hazrat Abdullah bin Tamir ne farmaya, "Sun ae badshah! Tu mere qatl par kabhi qadir na hoga yahan tak ke tu is deen ko maan le jise main manta hoon aur ek Allah ki ibadat karne lage. Agar yeh kar lega to phir tu mujhe qatl kar sakta hai." Badshah ne aisa hi kiya, us ne Hazrat Abdullah ka batlaya hua kalma parha aur musalman ho kar jo lakri us ke hath mein thi us se Hazrat Abdullah ko mara jis se kuch yunhi si kharash aayi aur isi se woh shaheed ho gaye. Allah un se khush ho aur apni khas rahmaten unhein inayat farmaye. Un ke sath hi badshah bhi mar gaya. Is waqiye ne logon ke dilon mein yeh baat paiwast kar di ke deen un ka hi sacha hai. Chunancha Najran ke tamam log musalman ho gaye aur Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke sache deen par qaim ho gaye aur wahi mazhab us waqt bar-haq bhi tha. Abhi tak Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) nabi ban kar duniya mein aaye na the lekin phir ek zamana ke baad un mein bid'atein paida hone lagin aur phail gayin aur deen-e-haq ka noor chhin gaya. Garz Najran mein Isaiyat ke phailne ka asli sabab yeh tha.

Ab ek zamana ke baad Zunawas Yahudi ne apne lashkar samet un Nasraniyon par charhai ki aur ghalib aa gaya. Phir un se kaha ya to Yahudiyat qabool kar lo ya maut. Unhon ne qatl hona manzoor kiya. Us ne khandaqein khudwa kar aag se pur kar ke un ko jala diya, baaz ko qatl bhi kiya, baaz ke hath paon naak kaan kaat diye waghera. Taqreeban bees hazar musalmanon ko sarkash ne qatl kiya aur is ka zikr aayat (Qutila Ashab-ul-Ukhdood) mein hai. Zunawas ka naam Zur'ah tha, us ki badshahat ke zamana mein use Yusuf kaha jata tha. Us ke baap ka naam Bayan As'ad Abi Karib tha jo Tubba' mashhoor hai jis ne Madina mein ghazwa kiya aur Ka'aba ko parda charhaya. Us ke sath do Yahudi aalim the, Yaman wale un ke hath par Yahudi mazhab mein dakhil hue. Zunawas ne ek hi din mein sirf subh ke waqt un khaiyon mein bees hazar iman walon ko qatl kiya. Un mein se sirf ek hi shakhs bach nikla jis ka naam Daws Zi-Tha'laban tha. Yeh ghore par bhag khara hua, go us ke peeche bhi ghore sawar doraye lekin yeh hath na laga. Yeh seedha Shah-e-Room Qaisar ke paas gaya, us ne Habsha ke badshah Najashi ko likha. Chunancha Daws wahan se Habsha ke Nasraniyon ka lashkar le kar Yaman aaya. Us ke sardar Aryat aur Abraha the. Yahudi maghloob hue, Yaman Yahudiyon ke hath se nikal gaya.

Zunawas bhaag nikla lekin woh paani mein gharq hogaya, phir sattar saal tak yahan Habsha ke Nasraniyon ka qabza raha. Bil-akhir Saif bin Zi-Yazan Humairi ne Fars ke baadshah se imdadi faujein apne saath lein aur saat sau qaidi logon se is par charhai kar ke fath hasil ki aur phir saltanat-e-Humairi qaim ki. Is ka kuch bayan Surah-e-Feel mein bhi aayega, Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq mein hai ke ek Najrani ne Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ke zamana mein Najran ki ek banjar ghair-abad zameen apne kisi kaam ke liye khodi to dekha ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Tamer (R.H) ka jism is mein hai. Aap baithe hue hain, sar par jis jagah chot aayi thi wahin haath hai, haath agar hatate hain to khoon behne lagta hai, phir haath ko chhod dete hain to haath apni jagah chala jata hai aur khoon tham jata hai. Haath ki ungli mein angoothi hai jis par 'Rabbi Allah' likha hua hai, yani mera Rab Allah hai. Chunancha is waqia ki ittila qasr-e-khilafat mein di gayi, yahan se Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ka farman gaya ke ise yunhi rehne do aur upar se mitti waghera jo hatayi hai, woh daal kar jis tarah tha usi tarah be-nishan kardo, chunancha yahi kiya gaya. Ibn-e-Abi-Dunya ne likha hai ke jab Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari (R.A) ne Isfahan fath kiya to ek deewar dekhi ke woh gir padi hai, un ke hukum par woh bana di gayi lekin phir gir padi, phir banwayi phir gir padi. Aakhir maloom hua ke is ke neeche koi nek-bakht shakhs madfoon hain. Jab zameen khodi to dekha ke ek shakhs ka jism khada hua hai, saath hi ek talwar hai jis par likha hai: "Main Haris bin Mazaz hoon, main ne khaiyon walon ka inteqam liya." Hazrat Abu Musa (R.A) ne is lashay ko nikal liya aur wahan deewar khadi kara di jo barabar rahi. Main kehta hoon yeh Haris bin Mazaz bin Amr Jurhami hai jo Ka'batullah ke mutawalli hue the, Sabit bin Ismail bin Ibrahim ki aulad ke baad. Is ka ladka Amr bin Haris bin Mazaz tha jo Makkah mein Jurham khandan ka aakhri baadshah tha, jis waqt ke Khuza'a qabeelay ne unhein yahan se nikala aur Yaman ki taraf jila-watan kiya. Yahi woh shakhs hai jis ne pehle pehle Arab mein sher kaha, jis sher mein weeran Makkah ko apna abad karna aur zamana ke her-pher aur inqilabat se phir wahan se nikala jana us ne bayan kiya. Is waqia se to maloom hota hai ke yeh qissa Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ke kuch zamana ka aur bahut purana hai jo ke Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ke taqreeban paanch sau saal ke baad ka maloom hota hai. Lekin Ibn-e-Ishaq ki is mutawwal riwayat se jo pehle guzri hai yeh sabit ho raha hai ke yeh qissa Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke baad ka aur Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se pehle ka hai, zyada theek bhi yahi maloom hota hai, Wallahu A'lam. Aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke yeh waqia duniya mein kayi baar hua ho, jaise ke Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki riwayat se maloom hota hai ke Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Jubair farmate hain ke Tubba ke zamana mein Yaman mein khandqein khudwayi gayi thin aur Qustuntin ke zamana mein Qustuntuniya mein bhi musalmanon ko yahi azab diya gaya tha.

Jabke Nasraniyon ne apna qibla badal diya, deen-e-Masih mein bid'atein ijaad kar lein, tauheed ko chhor baithe. Us waqt jo sachay deendar thay unhon ne un ka saath na diya aur asli deen par qaim rahay, toh un zalimon ne khandqein aag se bharwa kar unhein jala diya. Aur yehi waqea Babil ki zameen par Iraq mein Bakht-e-Nasr ke zamane mein hua jis ne ek but bana liya tha aur logon se usay sajda karata tha. Hazrat Daniyal A.S aur un ke dono saathi Uzair aur Mashail ne us se inkaar kar diya toh us ne unhein us aag ki khandq mein daal diya. Allah Ta'ala ne aag ko un par thanda kar diya, unhein salamti ata farmayi, saaf najaat di aur us sarkash kafiron ko un khandqon mein daal diya. Ye nau qabeelay thay, sab jal kar khaak ho gaye.

Suddi R.H farmatay hain teen jagah ye mamla hua: Iraq mein, Sham mein aur Yaman mein. Muqatil R.H farmatay hain ke khandqein teen jagah thin: ek toh Yaman ke shehar Najran mein, dusri Sham mein, teesri Fars mein. Sham mein is ka baani Antnanus Rumi tha aur Fars mein Bakht-e-Nasr aur zameen-e-Arab par Yusuf Zunawas. Fars aur Sham ki khandqon ka zikr Quran mein nahin, ye zikr Najran ka hai.

Hazrat Rabee bin Anas R.H farmatay hain ke hum ne suna hai fatrat ke zamane mein yani Hazrat Isa A.S aur Paighambar-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke darmiyan ke zamane mein ek qoum thi. Unhon ne jab dekha ke log fitnay aur shar mein giraftar ho gaye hain aur giroh giroh ban gaye hain aur har giroh apne khayalat mein khush hai, toh un logon ne unhein chhor diya. Yahan se hijrat kar ke alag ek jagah bana kar wahin rehna sehna shuru kiya aur Allah ki mukhlisana ibadat mein yaksooi ke saath mashghool ho gaye. Namazon ki pabandi, zakaton ki adaigi mein lag gaye aur un se alag thalag rehne lage. Yahan tak ke ek sarkash badshah ko is Allah wali jamaat ka pata lag gaya. Us ne un ke paas apne aadmi bheje aur unhein samjhaya ke tum bhi hamare saath mil jao aur but parasti shuru kar do. Un sab ne bilkul inkaar kiya ke hum se ye nahin ho sakta ke Allah Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ke siwa kisi aur ki bandagi karein. Badshah ne kehwaya ke agar ye tumhein manzoor nahin toh main tumhein qatl kara doonga. Jawab mila ke jo chaho karo lekin hum se deen nahin chhora jaye ga.

Us zalim ne khandqein khudwayein, aag jalwayi aur un sab mard-o-auraton aur bachon ko jama kar liya aur un khandqon ke kinaray khara kar ke kaha: bolo ye aakhri sawal-o-jawab hai, aaya but parasti qabool karte ho ya aag mein girna qabool karte ho? Unhon ne kaha humein jal marna manzoor hai. Lekin chhotay chhotay bachon ne cheekh-o-pukar shuru kar di, baron ne unhein samjhaya ke bas aaj ke baad aag nahin, na ghabrao aur Allah ka naam le kar kood paro. Chunancha sab ke sab kood paray, unhein aanch bhi nahin lagne payi thi ke Allah ne un ki roohein qabz kar lein aur aag khandqon se bahar nikal parri aur un badkirdar sarkashon ko gher liya aur jitne bhi thay saray ke saray jala diye gaye. Un ki khabar un aayaton "Qutila" mein hai.

Toh is bina par fitnon ke ma'ani huye ke jalaya, toh farmata hai ke in logon ne musalman mardon auraton ko jala diya hai, agar unhon ne tauba na ki yani apne is fe'l se baaz na aaye na apne is kiye par nadim huye toh un ke liye jahannam hai aur jalne ka azab hai, taake badla bhi un ke amal jaisa ho. Hazrat Hasan Basri (Rahimahullah) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala buzurg-o-bartar ke karam-o-rahm, us ki meherbani aur inayat ko dekho ke jab badkaron ne us ke pyare bandon ko aise badtareen azabon se mara, unhein bhi woh tauba karne ko kehta hai aur un se bhi maghfirat aur bakhshish ka wada karta hai. Allah hamein bhi apni wasee rehmaton se bharpoor hissa ata farmaye. Ameen.

Arsh ka maalik apne bandon se bahut pyaar karta hai, apne dushmanon ka anjaam bayaan kar ke apne doston ka natija bayaan farma raha hai ke un ke liye jannatein hain jin ke neeche neharein jaari hain, in jaisi kaamyabi aur kise milegi? Phir farmaya hai ke tere Rab ki pakad badi sakht hai, woh apne in dushmanon ko jo us ke rasoolon ko jhutlate rahe aur un ki nafarmaniyon mein lage rahe, sakht-tar quwwat ke saath is tarah pakdega ke koi raah-e-najaat un ke liye baaqi na rahe. Woh badi quwwaton wala hai, jo chaha kiya, jo kuch chahta hai woh ek lamha mein ho jata hai. Uski qudraton aur taqaton ko dekh kar, us ne tumhein pehle bhi paida kiya aur phir bhi maar daalne ke baad dobara paida kar dega, na use koi roke, na aage aaye, na saamne pade. Woh apne bandon ke gunahon ko maaf karne wala hai bashart-e-ke woh us ki taraf jhukein aur tauba karein aur us ke saamne naak ragdein, phir chahe kaisi hi khatayein hon ek dam mein sab maaf ho jati hain. Apne bandon se woh pyaar-o-mohabbat rakhta hai, woh Arsh wala hai jo Arsh tamam makhlooq se buland-o-bala hai aur tamam khalaiq ke upar hai. Majeed ki do qira'atein hain, daal ka pesh bhi aur daal ka zer bhi. Pesh ke saath woh Allah ki sifat ban jayega aur zer ke saath Arsh ki sifat hai, ma'ani donon ke bilkul sahih aur theek baithte hain. Woh jis kaam ka jab irada kare karne par qudrat rakhta hai, us ki azmat, adalat, hikmat ki bina par na koi use rok sake na us se pooch sake. Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) se un ki us bimari mein jis mein aap ka inteqal hota hai, log sawal karte hain ke kisi tabib ne bhi aap ko dekha? Farmaya haan. Poocha phir kya jawab diya? Farmaya ke jawab diya: "Inni fa'alun lima yureed". Phir farmata hai ke kya tujhe khabar bhi hai ke Firauniyon aur Samudiyon par kya kya azaab aaye aur koi aisa na tha ke un ki kisi tarah ki madad kar sakta, na koi aur is azaab ko hata saka. Matlab yeh hai ke us ki pakad sakht hai, jab woh kisi zaalim ko pakadta hai to dardnaaki aur sakhti se badi zabardast pakad pakadta hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) chale ja rahe the ke aap ne suna koi biwi sahiba Quran-e-Pak ki yeh aayat padh rahi hain: (Hal ataaka hadeethul junood - 85. Al-Burooj: 17). Aap khade reh gaye aur kaan laga kar sunte rahe aur farmaya: "Na'am qad ja'ani", ya'ani haan mere paas woh khabrein aa gayin, ya'ani Quran ki is aayat ka jawab diya ke kya tujhe Firauniyon aur Samudiyon ki khabar pahunchi hai? Phir farmaya ke balkeh kaafir shak-o-shuba mein, kufr-o-sarkashi mein hain aur Allah un par qaadir aur ghaalib hai, na yeh us se gum ho sakein na use aajiz kar sakein. Balkeh yeh Quran izzat aur karamat wala hai, woh Lauh-e-Mahfooz ka nawshta hai, buland martaba farishton mein hai, ziyadati kami se paak aur sar-ta-pa mehfooz hai, na is mein tabdeeli ho na tehreef.

Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain ke yeh Lauh-e-Mahfooz Hazrat Israfeel (A.S) ki peshani par hai, Abdur-Rahman bin Salman farmate hain ke duniya mein jo kuch hua, ho raha hai aur hoga woh sab Lauh-e-Mahfooz mein majood hai aur Lauh-e-Mahfooz Hazrat Israfeel (A.S) ki dono aankhon ke samne hai lekin jab tak unhein ijazat na mile woh ise dekh nahin sakte. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marvi hai ke Lauh-e-Mahfooz ki peshani par yeh ibarat hai, koi mabood nahin bajuz Allah Ta'ala ke, woh akela hai uska deen Islam hai, Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) uske bande hain aur uske Rasool hain (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam), jo Allah Ta'ala par iman laye, uske wade ko sacha jane, uske Rasoolon ki tabedari kare, Allah-e-Aalam use Jannat mein dakhil karega. Farmate hain yeh Lauh safed moti ki hai, iska tool aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan ke barabar hai aur iski chaudai mashriq-o-maghrib ke barabar hai, iske dono kinare moti aur yaqoot ke hain, iske dono patthe surkh yaqoot ke hain, iska qalam noor hai, iska kalam Arsh ke sath wabasta hai, iski asal farishte ki god mein hai, farmate hain yeh Allah ke Arsh ke dayen taraf hai. Tabrani mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne Lauh-e-Mahfooz ko safed moti se paida kiya, iske safhay surkh yaqoot ke hain, iska qalam noor ka hai, iski kitabat noor ki hai, Allah Ta'ala har din teen sau sath martaba ise dekhta hai, woh paida karta hai, rozi deta hai, marta hai, zindagi deta hai, izzat deta hai, zillat deta hai aur jo chahe karta hai. Alhamdulillah, Surah Burooj ki tafsir khatam hui.

Tabrani mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne Lauh-e-Mahfooz ko safed moti se paida kiya, iske safhay surkh yaqoot ke hain, iska qalam noor ka hai, iski kitabat noor ki hai, Allah Ta'ala har din teen sau sath martaba ise dekhta hai, woh paida karta hai, rozi deta hai, marta hai, zindagi deta hai, izzat deta hai, zillat deta hai aur jo chahe karta hai. Alhamdulillah, Surah Burooj ki tafsir khatam hui.

Arsh ka maalik apne bandon se bahut pyaar karta hai, apne dushmanon ka anjaam bayaan kar ke apne doston ka natija bayaan farma raha hai ke un ke liye jannatein hain jin ke neeche neharein jaari hain, in jaisi kaamyabi aur kise milegi? Phir farmaya hai ke tere Rab ki pakad badi sakht hai, woh apne in dushmanon ko jo us ke rasoolon ko jhutlate rahe aur un ki nafarmaniyon mein lage rahe, sakht-tar quwwat ke saath is tarah pakdega ke koi raah-e-najaat un ke liye baaqi na rahe. Woh badi quwwaton wala hai, jo chaha kiya, jo kuch chahta hai woh ek lamha mein ho jata hai. Uski qudraton aur taqaton ko dekh kar, us ne tumhein pehle bhi paida kiya aur phir bhi maar daalne ke baad dobara paida kar dega, na use koi roke, na aage aaye, na saamne pade. Woh apne bandon ke gunahon ko maaf karne wala hai bashart-e-ke woh us ki taraf jhukein aur tauba karein aur us ke saamne naak ragdein, phir chahe kaisi hi khatayein hon ek dam mein sab maaf ho jati hain. Apne bandon se woh pyaar-o-mohabbat rakhta hai, woh Arsh wala hai jo Arsh tamam makhlooq se buland-o-bala hai aur tamam khalaiq ke upar hai. Majeed ki do qira'atein hain, daal ka pesh bhi aur daal ka zer bhi. Pesh ke saath woh Allah ki sifat ban jayega aur zer ke saath Arsh ki sifat hai, ma'ani donon ke bilkul sahih aur theek baithte hain. Woh jis kaam ka jab irada kare karne par qudrat rakhta hai, us ki azmat, adalat, hikmat ki bina par na koi use rok sake na us se pooch sake. Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) se un ki us bimari mein jis mein aap ka inteqal hota hai, log sawal karte hain ke kisi tabib ne bhi aap ko dekha? Farmaya haan. Poocha phir kya jawab diya? Farmaya ke jawab diya: "Inni fa'alun lima yureed". Phir farmata hai ke kya tujhe khabar bhi hai ke Firauniyon aur Samudiyon par kya kya azaab aaye aur koi aisa na tha ke un ki kisi tarah ki madad kar sakta, na koi aur is azaab ko hata saka. Matlab yeh hai ke us ki pakad sakht hai, jab woh kisi zaalim ko pakadta hai to dardnaaki aur sakhti se badi zabardast pakad pakadta hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) chale ja rahe the ke aap ne suna koi biwi sahiba Quran-e-Pak ki yeh aayat padh rahi hain: (Hal ataaka hadeethul junood - 85. Al-Burooj: 17). Aap khade reh gaye aur kaan laga kar sunte rahe aur farmaya: "Na'am qad ja'ani", ya'ani haan mere paas woh khabrein aa gayin, ya'ani Quran ki is aayat ka jawab diya ke kya tujhe Firauniyon aur Samudiyon ki khabar pahunchi hai? Phir farmaya ke balkeh kaafir shak-o-shuba mein, kufr-o-sarkashi mein hain aur Allah un par qaadir aur ghaalib hai, na yeh us se gum ho sakein na use aajiz kar sakein. Balkeh yeh Quran izzat aur karamat wala hai, woh Lauh-e-Mahfooz ka nawshta hai, buland martaba farishton mein hai, ziyadati kami se paak aur sar-ta-pa mehfooz hai, na is mein tabdeeli ho na tehreef.
